context_for_next_testing_agent: P1.3 and P1.4 features fully tested. Key verified flows: (1) GET /api/payments/pricing-rules returns membership.sessionDiscountPercent=10 and membership.matchingPriorityBonus=0.15, (2) GET /api/memberships/member-badge/{user_id} returns isMember=true with benefits for active members, isMember=false for non-members, (3) GET /api/memberships/my-membership returns hasMembership status with membership.freeBoostsRemaining, (4) GET /api/boosts/analytics returns hasActiveBoost, totalImpressions, totalProfileViews, totalClicks, clickThroughRate, dailyData, (5) POST /api/boosts/{trainer_id}/track-view increments profileViews and clicks, (6) GET /api/trainers/nearby includes isBoosted and isMember flags for each trainer, (7) POST /api/memberships/subscribe returns 400 when already subscribed. Rate limiting active: 10/min for login.
